import os,json,subprocess,shutil
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/srv/projects/skill-universal')
cache=root/'.runtime/npm-cache/_cacache'
r={'scope':'Ferrari-only obsolete npm package download cache','status':'ABORTED','other_projects_touched':False}
def need(x,m):
 if not x:raise RuntimeError(m)
def free():f=os.statvfs('/srv/projects');return f.f_bavail*f.f_frsize
def check():
 b=root/'tools/android-cli-36.0.0'
 table={'apktool':(root/'tools/apktool-3.0.3/bin/apktool',['--version']),'AAPT2':(b/'build-tools/36.0.0/aapt2',['version']),'Apksigner':(b/'build-tools/36.0.0/apksigner',['--version']),'ADB':(b/'platform-tools/adb',['version'])}
 for name,(path,args) in table.items():
  need(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(),'missing '+name)
  proc=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/sudo','-n','-H','-u','ubuntu',str(path),*args],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=32)
  need(proc.returncode==0,name+' private tool version check failed')
 need((b/'build-tools/36.0.0/zipalign').is_file(),'missing Zipalign')
 need((root/'.runtime/npm/rea/node_modules/rea-agents/package.json').is_file(),'private REA missing')
try:
 need(os.geteuid()==0 and root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink(),'Ferrari canonical root absent')
 check()
 need(cache.is_dir() and not cache.is_symlink(),'only expected npm tarball cache may be purged')
 need(cache.resolve()==root/'.runtime/npm-cache/_cacache','npm cache resolves outside Ferrari')
 for proc in Path('/proc').iterdir():
  if not proc.name.isdecimal():continue
  try:
   cwd=os.readlink(proc/'cwd')
   need(not cwd.startswith(str(cache)),'active npm cache process')
   for fd in (proc/'fd').iterdir():
    try:t=os.readlink(fd)
    except OSError:continue
    need(not t.startswith(str(cache)),'npm cache held open')
  except (OSError,PermissionError,ProcessLookupError):pass
 before=free();shutil.rmtree(cache)
 need(not cache.exists(),'stale cache still exists')
 check()
 r.update(status='PASS',freed_bytes=free()-before,free_bytes=free(),rea_preserved=True,private_android_and_apktool_pass=True)
except Exception as e:r['error']=type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)[:230]
print(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=True,sort_keys=True))
